# Plan — Work identifier and title

**State:** Draft / Active / Complete
**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Accepted specification:** Link the numbered specification and accepted criteria for this slice.
**Delivery tracking:** Link the specification index; append actual commit/evidence and release details when verified/published, not merely when planned.

## Outcome and constraints

State the result, preserved behavior, and data/platform boundaries.

## Steps

1. Small coherent slice with a verification checkpoint.
2. Next dependent slice only if needed.

For parallel work, specify separate ownership and integration responsibility. Do not introduce parallelism merely because this planning format permits it.

## Verification and review

Focused tests, full gate, artifact/device checks, and what cannot be established automatically.

## Documentation and rollback

Affected documents, compatibility/migration effects, safe reversal or recovery.

## Handoff

Maintain the current step and exact continuation in the canonical status file; do not create a competing status ledger here.
